needs_atom.missing: Turn-scoped life-loss condition: 'if an opponent lost life this turn'. FAtomPred has LIFE_GAINED_THIS_TURN_GE and ThisTurnKind has LIFE_GAINED / CARDS_DRAWN / NONCOMBAT_DAMAGE, but nothing reads life lost this turn by a player (from damage or life loss). Needed: e.g. FAtomPred.LIFE_LOST_THIS_TURN_GE with who=OPPONENT and count 1 (or QThisTurn LIFE_LOST). The end-step trigger (TurnPhaseEvent END_TURN, actor YOU) and the +1/+1 counter on itself are expressible (Sabertooth Mauler shape).
